generation.whole_chain_rule: Primary strict chain rule: arrival + 20 * actual chain stage_num; finish <= deadline
generation.scheduler_request_slo_rule: Both arms receive the official client request SLO scaled by collection_id % 4 + 1; C chain-goal deadline uses this received value times actual stage_num
generation.official_native_goodput_rule: Reproduce the official request goodput using the official scaled collection-SLO convention; report it separately from primary unscaled strict-chain attainment and strict-chain call goodput

compat.selection: First three original public trace chains, no outcome filtering

full.selection: First six original public trace chains, frozen v42 DEV input

A_semantics: Native official AsyncLLMEngine/GPUExecutor/SLOScheduler/SLOPolicy/QRF/GraphMatchContext. No chain-level scheduling changes; only GPU identity and read-only audit wrappers.
comparability: Same physical GPU1, public prompts, arrival plan, per-chain deadlines, target outputs, seed, BF16 model, KV/token/sequence caps. Native-vs-shared backend differences remain a system boundary.
stop_rules: Compatibility A must pass before full A/B/C
Full A must pass before B; B before C
Stop if GPU1 is busy; never signal others
No HOLDOUT, matrix, added seeds, or resource changes
